posts.subject: Something for Doo Doo
posts.bodyHtml:
Well hello Dream Community I'm back from a week holiday but I want to leave a special message for a person that lifts me up all the time @Doo Doo ♥


Well Doo Doo we have went through a lot of in our friendship from downs and ups but you were ther on my side when I needed your help when I was down like titanic you were the first person to try to lift my spirits up, which worked you have put through a lot of my stupid mistakes and you dealt with them and you were there just to help me every time I felt let down there were 2 people I can message you and other special person in my life ( you know who ) but I want to say thanks for helping me and for putting with all my complaints and shitty attitude you have helped me a lot in developing into better mature person ( not just you as you know ) but the time you put into helping me and trying to make my day is just absolutely amazing without you I would sit most of the times sad as I would have no one to listen to all this nonsense. Sometimes the amout of hours you put into trying to make me a happy person is just unforgettable thank you for all the time you put into this and being there for me and ofc I could not forget that you're the first contact point that I have in case there is a problem on a Dream Knife server.


Thank you for being a good Friend/Best-Friend/Admin


Kindest Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.

[Bild] [Bild] [Bild] [Bild] [Bild] [Bild] [Bild] [Bild] ( Thanks in Polish )

Thanks a lot Oxygen :') I am more than happy to be your contact person as for anyone else. I'm just happy I can help another member of our Dream family and I really do hope you have changed your ways and moral so that maybe you will have the chance of achieving (and sustaining) your goal without our community.


Continue to strive for what you want 🙂


Thank you again,
~Doo Doo
